card.name: First piece of a drug name
card.fires_on: The first or an early piece of a drug name that is split into several parts, usually right after a word like 'with', 'of' or a comma in drug label text. Often brand names in capitals or generic names such as Hydro-codone.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: Opening piece of a capitalised brand name after 'with' or 'of'.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Formal drug interaction studies have not been performed with<< R>>ITUXAN. In patients with CLL

modes.label: Generic name start
modes.description: Opening or early piece of a generic drug name split into parts.
modes.example: As an opioid,<< Hydro>>codone Bitartrate and Hom

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; it seems to push toward continuing a name with an odd word piece.
card.plain: It lights up on the first chunk of a long drug name, just before the rest of the name follows.
